item.title: Pavement width insufficient for children., 7th July
item.description:
Church Road towards the auction house from where Farm Lane and Crippets Lane meet. Over 20 families with primary school aged kids walk along this path every day taking their lives in their own hands. The cars along the road often go well above the 30mph speed limit and they’re often no more than one foot from the children’s heads with their side view mirrors. The land bordering this pavement should be pushed back to provide the same width of pavement as the Highschool kids have along Kidnappers Lane.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Church Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
